name: Special Basic Mountaineering Course
benefit: The beneficiary will become a certified guide upon completing the mountaineering course.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a youth of Uttarakhand. 1. Preference will be given to candidates who have completed the Low Altitude Guide Course from a recognized institution or an Adventure Foundation Course run by DTDC. > The total number of 25 beneficiaries will be selected.
